systems.name: Ripple
systems.description: Generative-UI runtime published as two packages: @ripple-ui/core (framework-agnostic spec engine: schema, expressions, state, events, a headless runtime) and @ripple-ui/svelte (Svelte 5 renderer with ~220 widget types across marketing, premium, data, research, craft and motion packs). Renders declarative JSON specs (UISpec / UniversalSpec) into interactive UIs.

containers.name: @ripple-ui/core
containers.description: Framework-agnostic spec engine (packages/core). No DOM and no Svelte reachable from the root entry; subpaths /headless, /headless/slim, /schema, /manifest, /motion, /iso and /build keep heavy parts out of chat bundles.

components.name: Core Engine
components.description: Spec engine primitives: ExpressionResolver ({state.path}, {item.field}, ternary, arithmetic), EventDispatcher over a base dispatcher (set/api/navigate/toast/emit/open/pin/unpin/animate), the state store and mutators, the UISpec to UniversalSpec normalizer, spec audit, issues and mutator, the WidgetRegistry, theme and brand appliers, the data guard and safe-url checks. packages/core/src/core + src/security.

components.name: Schema
components.description: Type contracts for the two spec systems: UISpec (explicit widget tree with UINode), UniversalSpec (intent-based high-level spec), event handlers, brand, motion fields and WidgetTypes. packages/core/src/schema.

components.name: Headless Runtime
components.description: Resolves a spec into a plain tree with state and events and no renderer (runtime.ts, resolve-tree.ts), plus a slim build. Exported as @ripple-ui/core/headless and /headless/slim. packages/core/src/headless.

components.name: Widget Manifest
components.description: Widget descriptions, actions, the craft rules and the slim widget list that hosts and agents read to pick and validate widgets; the envelope that wraps a spec for transport. packages/core/src/manifest.

components.name: Motion System
components.description: Declarative node-level animation (RFC 12): the motion engine resolves presets and honours reduced motion (packages/core/src/motion). The with-motion Svelte action that attaches it to rendered nodes lives in packages/svelte/src/lib/actions. Reveal and Parallax sugar widgets desugar to motion fields.

components.name: Iso Kit + Build Loop
components.description: The isometric kit behind the iso-scene widget (solids, scene builder, detail pass, figure audit; packages/core/src/iso) and the build loop a node host runs to craft a spec in rounds (packages/core/src/build), used by the ripple skill and the pocketpaw worker.

containers.name: @ripple-ui/svelte
containers.description: The Svelte 5 renderer (packages/svelte/src/lib), published from dist/. Turns specs into interactive UI using @ripple-ui/core. Subpath exports: /widgets, /ui, /primitives, /schema, /streaming, /editor, /discover, theme.css, styles.css and the built manifest.json / manifest.slim.json.

components.name: Renderer
components.description: Ripple.svelte and NodeRenderer.svelte (recursive widget tree with show conditions, loop context and prop binding), the runes StateManager (state-manager.svelte.ts) and the toast bus. packages/svelte/src/lib + src/lib/components + src/lib/core.

components.name: Widget Registry
components.description: ~220 widget types (one manifest entry each) across ai, c4, call, composite, control, craft, data, data-kit, design-system, display, input, interactive, layout, media, motion, overlay, research, vertical and workflow categories, registered through core's WidgetRegistry. Figures (lazy 3D scenes) and sound cues ship beside them; scripts/build-manifest.ts emits the static-safe manifest. packages/svelte/src/lib/widgets.

components.name: Marketing + Premium Widgets
components.description: Landing and marketing widgets (Hero, Cta, FeatureGrid, Footer, Faq, Navbar, Testimonial, LogoCloud, Newsletter) and premium animated widgets (Marquee, BorderBeam, AnimatedBeam, Aurora, Spotlight, BentoGrid, TextEffect, Shimmer). packages/svelte/src/lib/widgets/marketing + widgets/premium.

components.name: Intent System
components.description: High-level intent rendering: IntentRenderer.svelte dispatches to LayoutEngine (picks a layout from intent type and data shape), PatternDetector (quiz/results patterns) and the named intent layouts. Falls back to the renderer for 'custom' intent. packages/svelte/src/lib/intent.

components.name: Dashboard Renderer
components.description: Draggable grid renderer for dashboard intents. DashboardRenderer.svelte manages slot registration, drag-and-drop reorder and resize; dashboard-manager.svelte.ts holds the grid state. packages/svelte/src/lib/intent.

components.name: Chain Flow
components.description: Client-side multi-step flow engine (RFC 13). ChainExecutor (chain-executor.svelte.ts) walks nested chain/chain_map UniversalSpec trees with zero round-trips, keeps per-step data, required-field gates and back/forward history. FlowRunner.svelte hosts it. packages/svelte/src/lib/intent.

components.name: Streaming
components.description: streamSpec renders a spec while it is still arriving: partial JSON parse, first paint and mid-stream display. Isolated as @ripple-ui/svelte/streaming. packages/svelte/src/lib/streaming.

components.name: Visual Editor
components.description: Inline editor overlay, inspector and drag layer over a rendered spec, with the selection model, editable-prop policy and one-op apply seam. Exported as @ripple-ui/svelte/editor. packages/svelte/src/lib/editor.

components.name: UI Kit
components.description: Shared building blocks the widgets are made of: ui, primitives, molecules, organisms, elevation and hover systems, theme.css and styles.css; plus the Discover catalogue kit (@ripple-ui/svelte/discover) and the illustration SVG sanitizer and URL sink guards (src/lib/security).

containers.name: Ripple Site
containers.description: The public docs and demo site built from packages/svelte/src/routes: home, docs, playground, showcase, the live landing, design-system and editor labs, llms.txt files, and the Paw Bar landing chat with its pay flow. Built with build:site and served as a static site.

containers.name: Ripple Skill
containers.description: The agent skill for writing crafted Ripple specs (skills/ripple): SKILL.md, widget and craft references with examples, and scripts that build, render, audit and critique a spec in rounds.

systems.name: paw-enterprise
systems.description: External: SvelteKit frontend that consumes @ripple-ui/core and @ripple-ui/svelte as file: deps on ../ripple/packages/*. Renders pocket UIs and admin surfaces via the Ripple runtime.

systems.name: PocketPaw
systems.description: External: agentic OS backend. Pockets produce rippleSpec JSON; the cloud site engine compiles the ripple track for static/dynamic Paw Sites; its worker runs the core build loop.

systems.name: Paw Bar
systems.description: External: the Paw Bar chat API. The site's landing chat calls it live only when PUBLIC_PAWBAR_LIVE=1; otherwise it plays a recorded replay.
